text:
Ada Chen: Quick check — onboarding aurora-13b: manifest points to gs://models/aurora/13b/weights/ but the manifest has "vocab_offset": 1 which doesn't match the tokenizer artifact (vocab starts at 0). runtime fails to align embeddings on load. any ideas? :eyes:
config-bot: automated lint: config.json schema v2.1: warning 'vocab_offset' not in allowed range [0,0].
Samir Patel: @Ada can you paste the manifest snippet? might be a packaging mismatch.
Ada Chen: sure, here's the top-level manifest excerpt:
```json
{
  "model_name": "aurora-13b",
  "weights_uri": "gs://models/aurora/13b/weights/",
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "bpe",
    "vocab_uri": "gs://models/aurora/13b/tokenizer/vocab.json",
    "vocab_offset": 1
  },
  "compiled_for": "cuda:2",
  "quant_profile": "int8-reduce"
}
```
Taylor Nguyen: If vocab_offset is 1 and the tokenizer binary was built expecting base-0, that shifts all special token ids (pad/eos) by +1 — explains the embedding alignment errors we saw.
Kevin Ortiz: Quick check: run the runtime-loader with DEBUG_TOKEN_MAP=1 and paste the startup mapping log so we can confirm the shift.
Ada Chen: ran debug flag, abbreviated startup log below:
```
[00:00:01] loader: loading tokenizer from gs://models/aurora/13b/tokenizer/
[00:00:01] tokenizer: detected vocab size=50258 (artifact says base=0)
[00:00:01] mapping: special token pad 0 -> 1 (shift detected) WARN
[00:00:02] runtime: embedding matrix shape mismatch: expected 50257, got 50258
```
Samir Patel: yep, artifact was packaged with index-base 1. options: (A) republish tokenizer manifest with vocab_offset=0 (preferred), (B) patch loader to accept offset=1 and create a translation table at startup.
Taylor Nguyen: we shouldn't proliferate runtime translation hacks. prefer repackaging + CI lint that rejects non-zero offsets unless explicitly marked legacy.
Ada Chen: I'll push a hotfix to model-packaging to normalize offsets during build so produced manifests always have vocab_offset=0 and add a migration for existing models. Pinging @Kevin for a dev-dedicated canary once I publish.
Kevin Ortiz: happy to run the canary on dev-dedicated. ETA ~30m. I'll report back in this thread. tagging for visibility.
config-bot: created task ENGML-4821 'normalize vocab_offset during packaging' assigned to Ada Chen.
Samir Patel: also add a unit test: build artifact -> load tokenizer -> assert manifest.vocab_offset == 0 and round-trip token ids. keeps regressions from slipping in.
Taylor Nguyen: +1 and add a lint rule: fail CI if vocab_offset != 0 unless manifest.legacy_tokenizer == true with a short rationale field.
Ada Chen: ack. I'll open the packaging PR and a follow-up PR to the config-lint rule. Will include a short note in onboarding readme about legacy vocab offsets and how we migrate.
Kevin Ortiz: canary passed (dev-dedicated): no mapping warnings after republish. closing loop in 10m with rollout to staging. :thumbsup:
